_source: Generated by backend/scripts/calibrate_race_post_relevance.py from app/data/race_post_relevance_labels.json. threshold is the lowest stored race_relevance cosine whose exact (Clopper-Pearson) lower 95% bound on precision is at least 0.8 (else the one with the highest bound), chosen on the oldest 67% of the labelled items that name their race and whose candidate is not known to be off the November ballot (by id, ingest order); held_out is the newest rest at that cut, not chosen from. precision_interval is the 95% Clopper-Pearson interval. dropped_for_not_naming_the_race is the labelled items the ingest now drops because they name neither the race's state nor another of its candidates; refused_for_a_candidate_off_the_november_ballot is the rest whose candidate the state's certified list leaves out, which the poster refuses.
